evidence_plan.requirement: Previously reported results on cue detection and scope resolution
Joint training vs single dataset training

payload.reason: The evidence provides specific details about previously reported results, improvements, and comparisons between models.

claims.text: Substantial improvements were reported over previously reported results by at least 0.29 F1 points on cue detection and 4.27 F1 points on scope resolution.
XLNet consistently outperforms BERT and RoBERTa, contrary to results on other benchmark datasets.
Joint training of the model on multiple datasets outperforms the single dataset training approach.
